sentences.en: In this way they are too tired to be frightening.
sentences.zh: 这样一来他们太累了而无法令人感到害怕。

sentences.en: Negotiating stairs for someone with a disability can be frightening.
sentences.zh: 对于有残疾的人来说，上下楼梯可能会非常吓人。

sentences.en: It was the most frightening experience I have ever had.
sentences.zh: 这是我经历过的最恐怖的经历。

senses.zh: 令人恐惧的,引起突然惊恐的,吓人
